rules.title: Rent Ordinance just cause eviction requirement
rules.requirement: To evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have one of the 17 just cause reasons listed in the Ordinance as the dominant motive for the eviction. The mere expiration of a rental agreement or a change in ownership is not just cause.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance, including some tenancies exempt from the rent increase limits: newly constructed rental units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979, tenancies eligible for a rent increase under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act, and some tenancies where the rent is regulated by another government agency.
rules.penalty: If a landlord evicts or tries to evict a tenant unlawfully, the landlord may be subject to substantial civil and/or criminal liability.
rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction. Note that the mere expiration of a rental agreement or a change in ownership does not constitute "just cause" for eviction.

rules.title: Just cause required to remove housing services
rules.requirement: A landlord needs a just cause reason to take away or remove access to certain housing services, such as garage and parking facilities, driveways, storage spaces and laundry rooms. A landlord who has complied with Ordinance Section 37.2(r) may temporarily remove certain housing services to perform mandatory soft-story seismic retrofit work.
rules.coverage_text: Housing services, including garage facilities, parking facilities, driveways, storage spaces, and laundry rooms, in rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Temporary removal of certain housing services, including parking and storage spaces, to perform mandatory soft-story seismic retrofit work required by the Building Code, by a landlord who has complied with Ordinance Section 37.2(r).
